exam.title: Building Intelligent Applications
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical low-code solution-building experience across Dataverse, model-driven and canvas apps, Power Automate, Power Fx and solutions, plus familiarity with Power Pages, Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder prompts/models, environment governance, security roles, responsible AI, ALM, accessibility, testing and troubleshooting.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Create a foundation for intelligent applications
Build business application logic and automation

review.notes: Every May 15, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a business outcome, component choice, data/security/identity boundary, app interaction, automation or AI contract, evidence, failure, or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight independent labs and 36 original checks cover the complete published scope. All 22 URLs are cataloged: 21 reachable and one Udemy page access-blocked. The September 7 watch adds the current harness crosswalk, Power Platform deprecation ledger, and roadmap transition while retaining independent course options as verification-required aids.

findings.title: SAP prompt knowledge support remains unclear
findings.evidence: Instructions include SAP; the limitations list does not.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Baseline drift includes an old audience summary
findings.evidence: Detailed objectives match; former snapshot abridged the audience text.
findings.recommendation: Archive old bytes and historical references, accept full current source normalization.
findings.resolution: Archive old bytes and historical references, accept full current source normalization.

findings.title: Completion labels can represent skipped generation
findings.evidence: 2000/2001 are skipped; definition edits do not recalculate rows.
findings.recommendation: Add detailed state/freshness example and evidence boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add detailed state/freshness example and evidence boundaries.

findings.title: Generic summaries exclude some Dynamics tables
findings.recommendation: Correct the case scenario and add scope/language/ALM limits.
findings.resolution: Correct the case scenario and add scope/language/ALM limits.

findings.title: Generated pages have separate authoring and export boundaries
findings.evidence: Regions differ by authoring route; published code and first prompt transfer without full history.

findings.title: Promotion preserves artifacts but excludes business data
findings.evidence: Same artifact moves through stages; target environments have distinct requirements.
findings.recommendation: Separate release artifacts from data recovery and Managed Environment licensing.
findings.resolution: Separate release artifacts from data recovery and Managed Environment licensing.

findings.title: Administrator tests bypass column protection
findings.evidence: System Administrator can read protected columns.
findings.recommendation: Require nonadministrator tests and separate generated-output protection.
findings.resolution: Require nonadministrator tests and separate generated-output protection.

findings.title: Local filtering can silently omit matches
findings.evidence: 500/2000 local prefixes do not establish query completeness.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic recall and missing-record example.
findings.resolution: Add synthetic recall and missing-record example.

findings.title: Chained writes can proceed after errors
findings.evidence: IfError controls further evaluation but cannot undo prior external effects.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish error handling, compensation and transaction boundaries.
findings.resolution: Distinguish error handling, compensation and transaction boundaries.

findings.title: App-to-agent extraction can omit actions
findings.evidence: Missing connections limit extraction; supported canvas route has prerequisites.

findings.title: Unchanged values can retrigger workflows
findings.evidence: Included selected columns trigger updates; Run As has distinct context.
findings.recommendation: Add operation/version deduplication and identity boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add operation/version deduplication and identity boundaries.

findings.title: A business approval can outlast one flow
findings.evidence: Pending approval does not remove 30-day run limit.
findings.recommendation: Add persisted response-processing pattern and deadline exercise.
findings.resolution: Add persisted response-processing pattern and deadline exercise.

findings.title: Older app instructions do not define current model availability
findings.evidence: Dedicated model catalog includes newer choices and model-specific settings.
findings.recommendation: Scope model/context/region/temperature guidance to current documentation.
findings.resolution: Scope model/context/region/temperature guidance to current documentation.

findings.title: Output shape and correctness require separate checks
findings.evidence: Saved format fixes structure but not authorized business values.
findings.recommendation: Add validation contract and original outcome metrics example.
findings.resolution: Add validation contract and original outcome metrics example.

findings.title: Credit retirement does not retire features or all active entitlements
findings.evidence: November change preserves eligible credits through existing contract term.
findings.recommendation: Add context/contract inventory and no-conversion/latency guidance.
findings.resolution: Add context/contract inventory and no-conversion/latency guidance.

findings.title: Rule scope differs by surface
findings.evidence: Form-only actions do not enforce every table write or canvas UI.
findings.recommendation: Add activation/scope matrix and supported-surface tests.
findings.resolution: Add activation/scope matrix and supported-surface tests.

findings.title: Rollups have asynchronous freshness and system-context access
findings.evidence: Consumers read stored aggregate and may see totals beyond visible details.
findings.recommendation: Add stale-decision example and aggregate protection.
findings.resolution: Add stale-decision example and aggregate protection.

findings.title: Learning outlines expose module counts without current runtimes
findings.recommendation: Mark old 15h26 historical and make the preparation budget editorial.
findings.resolution: Mark old 15h26 historical and make the preparation budget editorial.
